brief.audience: Households comparing recurring, reset, and move-related residential cleaning services
brief.primaryAction: Understand the service fit and send an unconfigured quote inquiry
brief.content: Fictional Commonwell Homekeeping demonstration. Service details and package labels are illustrative. No customer reviews, performance statistics, real prices, bookings, contact coordinates, or delivery claims.
brief.imagery: Distinct documentary home and cleaning scenes with a pine, oat, paper, and marigold identity; original arched-doorway logo system.

directions.thesis: A warm editorial service brand that treats a clean home as practical breathing room, framed by an arched-doorway mark and useful room-by-room detail.

fingerprint.header: paper masthead with arched logo and compact native menu
fingerprint.hero: pine editorial panel joined to close cleaning photography
fingerprint.textAnchor: left-aligned serif statements with small utility labels
fingerprint.inventory: open service bands and an illustrative comparison ledger
fingerprint.cta: marigold inquiry prompt and explicit unconfigured form
fingerprint.footer: compact pine bar with reverse logo and one wrapping link group

directions.comparison: Authored draft. Warmer and more household-focused than the grid-led alternatives; awaits user review and selection.

sections.purpose: Frame cleaning as usable time at home
sections.composition: deep-color copy panel beside close documentary cleaning image
sections.typography: serif statement with utility sans labels

sections.purpose: Help visitors choose a service without invented pricing
sections.composition: three open bands with suitability and scope
sections.imagery: room scenes used only where they clarify

directions.thesis: A lighter household fieldbook organized by rooms, checklists, and preparation notes.

fingerprint.header: thin forest rule and small mark
fingerprint.hero: full kitchen image with paper caption

directions.comparison: More instructional and image-led than Open Door Standard; retained as an unselected fingerprint only.

sections.composition: large room image with attached notes

directions.comparison: Brighter and more campaign-like than Open Door Standard; retained as an unselected fingerprint only.
